python3 - <<'PY'
import time
import serial

port = '/dev/cu.usbserial-1130'
ser = serial.Serial()
ser.port = port
ser.baudrate = 115200
ser.timeout = 0.2
ser.dtr = False
ser.rts = False
ser.open()
print('SERIAL_OPEN_OK', port, ser.baudrate)
end = time.monotonic() + 65.0
buf = b''
lines = []
bytes_read = 0
while time.monotonic() < end:
    data = ser.read(4096)
    if not data:
        continue
    bytes_read += len(data)
    buf += data
    while b'\n' in buf:
        raw, buf = buf.split(b'\n', 1)
        lines.append(raw.decode(errors='replace').rstrip('\r'))
ser.close()
if buf:
    lines.append(buf.decode(errors='replace').rstrip('\r'))
print('SERIAL_READ_BYTES', bytes_read)
print('SERIAL_LINES', len(lines))
patterns = ('scd', 'co2', 'sensor', 'sample', 'i2c', 'environment', 'telemetry')
print('FILTERED_BEGIN')
for line in lines:
    lower = line.lower()
    if any(token in lower for token in patterns):
        print(line)
print('FILTERED_END')
print('TAIL_BEGIN')
for line in lines[-80:]:
    print(line)
print('TAIL_END')
PY
